glosses: The part of the body connecting the head and the trunk found in humans and some animals.

examples.text: Giraffes have long necks.
Mother, help me, there's a head attached to my neck and I'm in it.

examples.text: Archegonia are surrounded early in their development by the juvenile perianth, through the slender beak of which the elongated neck of the fertilized archegonium protrudes.

glosses: To hang by the neck; strangle; kill, eliminate.

glosses: To intently kiss or cuddle; to canoodle.

examples.text: Alan and Betty were necking in the back of a car when Betty's dad caught them.

Molly had been in love with Sick Boy since he necked with her in a seedy disco-bar in Leith a few weeks ago. Sick Boy had made a drunken point about HIV transmission and to illustrate it had spent most of the night french-kissing her.

glosses: To drink or swallow rapidly.

examples.text: Actually, mostly I swan around in my silver sports car, necking drugs, and feeling sorry for myself.
In the dim light, punters sit sipping raspberry-flavoured Tokyo martinis, losing the freestyle sushi off their chopsticks or necking Asahi beer.
The 40-year-old [Mike Skinner] is happy to put his body on the line in other ways, swapping a mug of tea for a fan's double pint of lager and messily necking it in one.

glosses: To decrease in diameter.

examples.text: Since this temperature would place the bolt in its creep range, it will slowly stretch, necking down as it does so. Eventually it will get too thin to support the weight, and the bolt will break.

glosses: A shapeshifting water spirit in Germanic mythology and folklore; a nix.

examples.text:
The Neck no more upon the river sings.
And no Mermaid to bleach her linen flings
Upon the waves in the mild solar ray.

The beautiful Nix or Nixie who allures the young fisher or hunter to seek her embraces in the wave which brings his death, the Neck who seizes upon and drowns the maidens who sport upon his banks, the river-spirit who still yearly in some parts of Germany demands tribute of human life, are all forms of the ancient Nicor[.]

examples.text: De tanden werden gevonden in 21 miljoen jaar oude gesteentes aan de Noord-Amerikaanse kant van de landengte van Panama. Vermoedelijk behoren ze toe aan een apensoort die de oversteek tussen Zuid- en Noord-Amerika al had gemaakt voor de landengte beide continenten 3,5 miljoen jaar geleden met elkaar verbond. Voor die tijd werden de continenten gescheiden door een stuk oceaan. Daarom vermoeden de onderzoekers dat het dier de oversteek per toeval maakte, bijvoorbeeld door op een boomstam naar de overkant van het water te drijven.

Op de landengte van Tehuantepec staat altijd een straffe wind, dat maakt het een van de beste plaatsen ter wereld om windenergie op te wekken. Sinds 1994 zijn er al 24 windparken verrezen in de regio. Het door PGGM gefinancierde project zou met 132 molens en 396 megawatt het grootste van Mexico worden. Het project is begroot op 750 miljoen euro. Naast PGGM stapten Mitsubishi en de Australische investeringsgroep Macquarie in.
